svg.title: Direct subtraction versus a stable identity for one minus cosine
svg.desc: A logarithmic plot shows the relative disagreement between direct computation of one minus cosine of x and the algebraically equivalent stable identity two sine squared of x over two. The disagreement reaches 100 percent for very small angles, including x equal to ten to the minus eight radians, where direct subtraction rounds to zero.
